unsupported: THACO INDUSTRIES USA LLC is headquartered in Gardena, California, and operates as the U.S. subsidiary of THACO INDUSTRIES, a sub-holding of the Vietnamese conglomerate THACO.

The company was established to extend THACO’s integrated manufacturing footprint into North American markets, leveraging a centralized production model based in Chu Lai–Da Nang City and Binh Co–Ho Chi Minh City.
THACO serves automotive OEMs and Tier‑1 suppliers globally, with exports to the United States, Canada, Australia, Russia, South Korea, and Japan.
